basis: The same company as ydeon-group (A-Z Gartenhaus, renamed YDEON Group): 3i agreed in September 2020 to buy the majority, and Project A's October 2020 investment 'was made as a co-investment with the private equity firm 3i Group' (Deutsche Startups dealmonitor). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3); the merge into ydeon-group cannot run because that row is excluded.

The same company as luqom-group (Lampenwelt, now LUQOM Group): 3i bought the majority in March 2017 and Project A agreed with 3i to invest in October 2017, 'the third private equity co-investment' (Private Equity News); 3i still holds the majority. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3); the merge into luqom-group cannot run because that row is excluded.
